name: Ali-Shir Nava'i
contribution: A Timurid poet, writer, statesman, linguist, Hanafi Maturidi mystic and painter who was the greatest representative of Chagatai literature.
legacy: Due to his distinguished Chagatai language poetry, this person is considered by many throughout the Turkic-speaking world to be the founder of early Turkic literature.

checks.lead: Ali-Shir Nava'i (9 February 1441 – 3 January 1501), also known as Nizām-al-Din ʿAli-Shir Herawī  (Chagatai: نظام الدین علی شیر نوایی) was a Timurid poet, writer, statesman, linguist, Hanafi Maturidi mystic and painter who was the greatest representative of Chagatai literature.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
